definition.en: NIMZs are giant industrial townships designed to act as hubs for manufacturing and investment, aimed at enhancing the share of the manufacturing sector in India's GDP.
definition.hi: NIMZs are giant industrial townships designed to act as hubs for manufacturing and investment, aimed at enhancing the share of the manufacturing sector in India's GDP.

importanceInUpsc.en: NIMZs are a critical component of the National Manufacturing Policy, frequently appearing in GS-3 questions regarding industrial infrastructure and economic growth. Understanding these zones is essential for analyzing government initiatives to boost the 'Make in India' campaign and improve the ease of doing business.
